what_is_it.explanation: React is a JavaScript library for building web and native user interfaces using a component-based architecture. Components manage their own state in JavaScript, allowing React to efficiently update and render views when application data changes. It supports JSX syntax for UI description and can render on the client, on the server with Node, or on mobile via React Native.
what_is_it.one_line: A JavaScript library for building web and native user interfaces using component-based and declarative patterns.
